title: Unify Selection Windows as UI Components
description: Refactor semio algorithms window kinds so selection-specific windows are semio/ui component specializations instead of separate bespoke window kinds. Piece selection should be implemented as a Diagram variant with restricted selection behavior, and the same pattern should apply to related selection windows. Update existing implementation and extend existing tests only; do not add new test files.
summary:
Fixed the MCP app black screen issue caused by missing Tailwind CSS processing in the Vite build pipeline.

Root cause: The MCP app's Vite config lacked the `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin, the entry point didn't import the CSS file, and Tailwind v4's scanner couldn't find utility class usage because it only scans from the CSS entry file's directory.

Three fixes applied:
1. Added `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin to `vite.mcp-app.config.ts`
2. Added `import "@semio/ui/globals.css"` to `mcp-app.tsx` entry point
3. Added `@source` directives to `semio/ui/globals.css` to tell Tailwind v4 scanner where to find class usage across `semio/ui/` and `elements/ui/`

The rebuilt `dist/mcp-app.html` grew from 802KB to 2441KB and now includes all Tailwind utility classes, theme CSS variables, and component styles. All 164 engine tests pass.
